    Monomorphisms, epimorphisms and zero objects of finitely generated modules #

    For a Noetherian ring R, a morphism of FGModuleCat R is a monomorphism iff it is injective, an epimorphism iff it is surjective, and an isomorphism iff it is bijective; an object is zero iff its carrier is a subsingleton. These transfer the corresponding facts about ModuleCat R along the forgetful functor, which is fully faithful and preserves finite limits and colimits. The underlying linear map of a finite sum of morphisms is the sum of the underlying linear maps (hom_hom_sum).
